productcatalogservice's own p95 latency is low (0.48ms), indicating it is not slow processing requests itself, but the slow calls are observed from callers, suggesting network or resource issues.

checkoutservice->productcatalogservice calls are slow (57.77ms avg vs 0.26ms healthy), frontend->productcatalogservice calls are slow (28.04ms avg vs 0.24ms healthy), and recommendationservice->productcatalogservice calls are slow (35.34ms avg vs 0.96ms healthy).

CPU usage of productcatalogservice is 48% of its limit (0.005 of 0.010 cores), so it is not CPU throttled, but the CPU limit was recently reduced from 200m to 10m, which may cause resource exhaustion or scheduling delays.
The pod of productcatalogservice was recreated 331s ago, coinciding with the CPU limit change, indicating a configuration change impact.
No errors are observed on productcatalogservice or its callers, so the issue is latency, not crash or errors.
The slow calls propagate latency upward to checkoutservice and frontend, causing frontend's p95 latency to be high (493.08ms).
